newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-UDINESE SAY MANCHESTER UTD MADE BID FOR BIERHOFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UDINESE SAY MANCHESTER UTD MADE BID FOR BIERHOFF.

text.p: Italian serie A club Udinese said on Monday that they had rejected an offer by Manchester United for German striker Oliver Bierhoff.
Carlo Piazzolla, the northern side's director general, at first hotly denied that the club had received a bid from the English club but later changed his position.

The Italian news agency ANSA quoted him as saying that he had spoken to majority shareholder Giampaolo Pozzo whom he said claimed United had offered a staggering 30 billion lire ($18 million) for the player.
"But he said Bierhoff was not for sale," he added.
The Italian daily Corriere dello Sport newspaper reported earlier on Monday that United were after Middlesbrough's Italian striker Fabrizio Ravanelli for a similar amount.
